label: A Book of Anatomy
summary: A dissection manual such as Mondino de' Luzzi's Anathomia, the standard text of the anatomy theater.

value.text: no. 109, Medicine, Anatomy, Astrology and Miscellany

claims.statement: Entered as no. 109 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Medicine, Anatomy, Astrology and Miscellany. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "a book of anatomy".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Anathomia. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
Composition and printing as given in the reconstruction: Composed 1316 · Printed 1478.
check_in: ISTC (Incunabula Short Title Catalogue) or Edit16 record for the edition
